tickets.subject: Password reset not working
tickets.initial_message: I've tried resetting my password 3 times but never receive the email. Can you help?
tickets.resolution: Reset user password manually and sent temporary password via email. Issue was spam filter blocking our domain. Suggested whitelist.

tickets.subject: Salesforce connector keeps disconnecting
tickets.initial_message: Our Salesforce connector keeps failing every few hours. Last sync was 6 hours ago. This is blocking our dashboard.
tickets.resolution: Checked Salesforce app settings - API key had been revoked. Regenerated key and reconnected. Verified 3 successful syncs.

tickets.subject: Custom metric calculation formula error
tickets.initial_message: I'm trying to create a profit margin metric with formula (revenue - costs) / revenue but it's returning null values.
tickets.resolution: Discovered 'costs' column had some null values. Fixed with COALESCE(costs, 0). Formula now works. Provided documentation on handling null values.

tickets.subject: Upgrade from Starter to Growth - need team member access
tickets.initial_message: We're upgrading to Growth plan. How do I add 5 more team members and change their permissions?
tickets.resolution: Processed upgrade, confirmed Growth plan active. Sent link to Settings → Users. Team can invite 10 users total with role assignment.

tickets.subject: Google Analytics data not matching TechFlow
tickets.initial_message: Google Analytics shows 15000 visitors but TechFlow shows 12000. Why the discrepancy?
tickets.context: User is comparing raw GA data vs TechFlow aggregated metrics. Likely filter difference but needs investigation.
tickets.escalated_reason: Data validation discrepancy - requires deeper investigation of metric definitions

tickets.subject: API rate limit being hit
tickets.initial_message: Zapier integration keeps failing with rate limit errors. We're only making ~500 req/min but getting 429 responses.
tickets.resolution: Found that Growth plan has 1000 req/min limit but was shared across 2 integrations. Recommended batching API calls and using webhooks instead.

tickets.subject: SSO setup for Okta
tickets.initial_message: We need to set up SAML 2.0 SSO with our Okta directory. Can you provide setup instructions?
tickets.resolution: Sent SAML configuration guide with entity ID, ACS URL, and certificate. Helped verify Okta setup. SSO tested successfully.

tickets.subject: Export dashboard as PDF
tickets.initial_message: Is there a way to export a dashboard as PDF for our presentation to investors?
tickets.resolution: Starter tier can export as PDF via Dashboard menu → Export. Sent screenshot showing option. File includes all widgets and current filters.

tickets.subject: HubSpot custom field mapping issue
tickets.initial_message: We have custom fields in HubSpot that aren't showing up in TechFlow. How do I map them?
tickets.resolution: Led through HubSpot connector → Advanced Mapping. Showed how to select custom fields. Note: Some rich text/encrypted fields not supported. Workaround: export from HubSpot.

tickets.subject: Real-time data sync configuration
tickets.initial_message: We need real-time data syncs from our data warehouse. Is this available and how does it work?
tickets.resolution: Enterprise feature available via webhooks. Explained architecture: your system sends events via webhook when data changes. Set up webhook endpoint and IP whitelist.

tickets.subject: Dashboard takes too long to load
tickets.initial_message: My dashboard with 20 widgets takes 30 seconds to load. How can I speed this up?
tickets.resolution: Suggested reducing date range from 2 years to 90 days. Removed 5 low-priority widgets. Load time reduced to 5 seconds. Sent performance optimization guide.

tickets.subject: Anomaly detection not catching expected outlier
tickets.initial_message: Our revenue dropped 50% yesterday but anomaly detection didn't flag it. Why?
tickets.resolution: Model needs 30-day baseline. Customer only 2 weeks old. Explained will improve over time. Temporarily lowered sensitivity to Medium. Will auto-improve.

tickets.subject: Custom connector for proprietary data source
tickets.initial_message: We have a proprietary internal data source that's not in your standard connectors. Can we build a custom integration?
tickets.context: Enterprise customer willing to invest in custom development
tickets.escalated_reason: Custom development request - requires engineering scope/pricing discussion

tickets.subject: Billing discrepancy - double charge?
tickets.initial_message: I see two charges of $499 this month. One at beginning of month and one today. Why?
tickets.resolution: First charge: monthly renewal. Second charge: pro-rata upgrade from Starter to Growth. Both correct. Sent itemized invoice explaining charges.

tickets.subject: How to export large dataset
tickets.initial_message: I need to export 100K rows from a table but export is capped at 50K. What are my options?
tickets.resolution: Starter tier limited to 50K CSV export. Suggested: (1) Upgrade to Growth for larger exports, (2) Use API with pagination, (3) Split export into 2 queries.

tickets.subject: SOC 2 audit documentation request
tickets.initial_message: Our compliance team needs SOC 2 Type II documentation. Can you provide this?
tickets.resolution: Sent SOC 2 Type II report (valid through Dec 2025) under NDA. Included controls overview and audit procedures summary.

tickets.subject: Two-factor authentication setup
tickets.initial_message: I want to enable 2FA on my account. How do I do this?
tickets.resolution: Settings → Security → 2FA. Choose authenticator app or SMS. Provided instructions for Google Authenticator and Authy. Backup codes saved.

tickets.subject: Workspace deletion request
tickets.initial_message: We're no longer using TechFlow. How do I delete our workspace?
tickets.resolution: Verified account ownership via email confirmation. Deleted workspace and all associated data. Confirmed cancellation on next billing cycle (no charges).

tickets.subject: API webhook signature validation
tickets.initial_message: How do I validate webhook signatures from TechFlow? We want to ensure requests are genuine.
tickets.resolution: Sent webhook documentation with HMAC-SHA256 validation code. Provided test webhook endpoint. Shared sample secret and signature generation logic.

tickets.subject: Dedicated account manager assignment
tickets.initial_message: As an Enterprise customer, who is our dedicated account manager?
tickets.resolution: Assigned Sarah Johnson as dedicated AM. Sent contact info and calendar link for first QBR (quarterly business review) scheduled for next month.
